label: Modal ontological case controls (inference)
rule: Evaluate the five finite models by simp
meaning: Premise-free finite models at standpoint false of two-world, two-candidate profiles with universal access (reflexive and Euclidean), every candidate GOD_4 and concrete (category-constant). onlyHere omits the boxed conditional, nobody omits possibility, swapped omits persistence; each keeps the other four premises and falsifies both conclusions. fixedOne satisfies all five premises and both conclusions (one candidate at both worlds, the other nowhere). fixedPlusVisitor satisfies the GOD_4 conclusion and persistence and falsifies rigidity. Models witness only their formal interpretation.
